rationale: The short thesis remains intact as TTWO continues to trade below both the session VWAP ($218.30) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($219.60) just 2 minutes after entry. After reaching a low of $216.84 on elevated volume (51,150 shares), the subsequent bounce back to $218.01 occurred on less than 40% of that volume (19,540 shares), indicating a standard low-volume retest of the VWAP breakdown level rather than a trend reversal. With the mechanical invalidation at $219.70 well-defined and the current spread wide at 25.2 bps, holding allows the breakdown setup time to play out without paying unnecessary spread costs.
